title: 第十三章尾随的徐云峰第十四章测试力量
content_zh:
;;
来到后厨。
只见在一个八方桌上，早已摆放好着最后一碗冒着热气腾腾的汤药。
一位身穿围裙的中年大妈在围裙上擦了擦手。
“你这小伙子再不来，这碗汤药我可就要自己喝了！”
江宁讪讪一笑：“抱歉！刚刚练拳不好中断！！”
“别说这些没用的，快点喝掉这碗汤药，汤药若是凉了药效可就没这么好了！”身穿围裙的中年大妈开口。
江宁也不再多言，连忙从桌上拿起最后一碗黑色的汤药。
在鼻尖闻了闻，他就感受到一股并不好闻的气息。
旋即，他屏住呼吸，大口大口的灌入喉中。
呼——
直到整碗汤药入腹，他才长长的吐了一口气。
“走了，该回家了！”有人开口，陆陆续续的走出后厨的院子。。
夕阳此时彻底沉入山背，天光越来越暗，夜幕也开始降临。
......
走出沧浪武馆后，江宁又回头看了一眼身后的武馆。
下一刻，他大步朝着城外走去，身上渐渐没有了刚刚练拳结束的那股虚弱感。
“武馆的汤药果然不错，虽然没有野参的效果来的明显，但是每天一碗，却也不亏！”
江宁有些兴奋走在路上，突然间，他神情微变，眼神骤然一凝。
只见远处的街角，徐云峰身穿捕快服，右手搭在腰间握着制式长刀，他看着江宁露出淡淡的笑容，却仿佛一条毒蛇。

看着朝外城走去的江宁，徐云峰亦步亦趋的吊在江宁身后，不远也不近。
旁人看上去，只会觉得这个捕快正在例行巡街。
从内城的沧浪武馆来到外城的住所，江宁足足走了一个小时。
他也一直沿着城中的大道走，拒绝一切人影稀少的小道。
......
外城。
江黎坐在院子，看到江宁身影的那一刻，他脸上露出笑容。
下一刻。
他脸色瞬间一冷，眼神也骤然变得凌厉。
“黎兄！”徐云峰看着江黎的目光，不以为意的笑了笑。
“徐云峰，你可别太过分了！！！”
“黎兄何出此言啊？”徐云峰再次笑了笑：“最近城中有些乱，各大帮派频频发生械斗，我一路护送令弟回家，黎兄怎么非但不感谢，反而像对待杀弟仇人啊！”
听到这番话，江黎眼中杀机凌厉。
徐云峰见此，丝毫不以为意，他旋即又笑了笑：“黎兄尽管放心，以后但凡碰到令弟，我都会一路护送，防止令弟被那些帮派中不长眼的家伙伤了！”
即使此刻江黎再蠢，也完全听出了徐云峰话中蕴含的意思。
看着徐云峰离去的身影，江黎心中不由的充满无力感。
如果是以前，面对如此嚣张的徐云峰他完全敢握刀砍去。
可是此时，右手一废，他的一身功夫十去八九，如何是即将入品的徐云峰对手。
而他身后不止有胞弟，还有妻子和子女。
content_en:
;;
Come to the kitchen.
I saw that on a Bafang table, the last bowl of steaming soup had already been placed.
A middle-aged woman in an apron wiped her hands on the apron.
"If you don't come here, young man, I will drink this bowl of medicine myself!"
Jiang Ning smiled: "Sorry! I just had to practice boxing and it was hard to interrupt!!"
"Don't say these useless things. Drink this bowl of soup quickly. If the soup is cold, it won't be as effective!" The middle-aged aunt in an apron said.
Jiang Ning stopped talking and quickly picked up the last bowl of black soup from the table.
After sniffing it at the tip of his nose, he felt an unpleasant smell.
Immediately, he held his breath and poured it into his throat.
Huh——
He didn't let out a long breath until the whole bowl of soup was in his stomach.
"Let's go, it's time to go home!" Someone said and walked out of the backyard of the kitchen one after another. .
At this time, the setting sun completely sank into the back of the mountain, the sky became darker and darker, and night began to fall.
...
After walking out of Canglang Martial Arts Hall, Jiang Ning looked back at the martial arts hall behind him.
The next moment, he strode towards the outside of the city, and the feeling of weakness that he had just finished practicing boxing gradually disappeared from his body.
"The decoction in the martial arts school is really good. Although it is not as effective as wild ginseng, one bowl a day is not a loss at all!"
Jiang Ning was walking on the road with excitement. Suddenly, his expression changed slightly and his eyes suddenly condensed.
On the street corner in the distance, Xu Yunfeng was wearing a police officer's uniform, with his right hand on his waist holding a standard long knife. He looked at Jiang Ning with a faint smile, but he looked like a poisonous snake.
Looking at Jiang Ning walking towards the outer city, Xu Yunfeng hung behind Jiang Ning step by step, neither far nor close.
To others, they would just think that the police officer was on routine patrol.
Jiang Ning walked for a full hour from Canglang Martial Arts School in the inner city to his residence in the outer city.
He also kept walking along the main roads in the city, rejecting all the paths with few people.
...
Outer city.
Jiang Li was sitting in the yard. The moment he saw Jiang Ning's figure, a smile appeared on his face.
The next moment.
His face turned cold instantly, and his eyes suddenly became sharp.
"Brother Li!" Xu Yunfeng looked at Jiang Li and smiled nonchalantly.
"Xu Yunfeng, don't go too far!!!"
"Brother Li, why did you say that?" Xu Yunfeng smiled again: "There has been some chaos in the city recently, and there have been frequent armed fights among the major gangs. I escorted your brother home all the way. Brother Li, instead of thanking me, he treated me like the enemy who killed me!"
Hearing these words, Jiang Li's eyes were filled with murderous intent.
When Xu Yunfeng saw this, he didn't take it seriously at all. He immediately smiled and said, "Brother Li, don't worry. Whenever I meet your brother in the future, I will escort him all the way to prevent him from being hurt by those blind guys in the gang!"
No matter how stupid Jiang Li was at this moment, he still completely understood the meaning behind Xu Yunfeng's words.
Seeing Xu Yunfeng's leaving figure, Jiang Li couldn't help but feel powerless in his heart.
If it were before, he would have dared to chop off such an arrogant Xu Yunfeng with a knife.
But at this moment, his right hand was gone, and his kung fu was almost completely gone. How could he be the opponent of Xu Yunfeng who was about to enter the first level?
And he is survived not only by his brothers, but also by his wife and children.
